normalization.linear_or_distance_models: fit scaler on training split only
normalization.raw_signal_models: deferred to the later CNN step

outlier_policy: preserve; flag but do not remove without sensor-error evidence
class_imbalance_policy: report 2:1 damaged-to-healthy ratio; do not apply SMOTE by default

split.rule: All windows from one measurement must remain in exactly one split.
split.limitation: Bearing identity is shared across splits; results do not estimate unseen-bearing generalization.

leakage_guard: assert_no_group_leakage(train measurement IDs, test measurement IDs)
